description: Windows file utility that opens a radial action wheel for converting, editing, and managing files.
pre_uninstall: Add-Type -Namespace ScoopOrbitDrop -Name ShellNotify -MemberDefinition '[System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImport("shell32.dll")] public static extern void SHChangeNotify(uint eventId, uint flags, System.IntPtr item1, System.IntPtr item2);'
notes: Uses the official portable ZIP rather than the setup executable, so Scoop controls the application files and updates.
OrbitDrop stores settings in %APPDATA%\OrbitDrop and logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\OrbitDrop; these locations are outside the Scoop app directory and remain after uninstall.
The portable build does not install updates itself. Use 'scoop update orbitdrop' to update this Scoop-managed copy.
The current upstream release is 0.6.0-alpha. The project notes that multi-monitor, mixed-DPI, and Windows 10 validation is still pending.
The app registers its File Explorer context-menu handler under HKCU. pre_uninstall removes the associated per-user registry entries and startup value.
